predictions.text: Poilus escaping from a gas bomb. During a recent attack on Hartnarswailerkopf, Alsace, French soldiers were using liquid fire on the German line when a huge Boche bomb burst in their trench and poured out a vast quantity of flame and black, poisonous smoke. The French soldiers are shown escaping down the trench a telephone repair man in the lead. The photographer filed too as soon as he snapped this picture for all recognized the bomb as one of the latest types of Boche Deadliness. Gas and liquid fired and the barrage are ever increasing factors in warfare and the United States will use them too when our men get into the trenches. The regular army, the national guard and the national duty will each have its gas and flame regime, besides many other specialized branches of the service. / WAR BY FIRE AND POISON.
